technical_scope: Three utility/computation parties, two padded asset slots each and six public demand locations; binary private declared eligibility and per-scenario availability/retention.
function: For every listed nonempty demand subset up to max_claims, an injective eligible available nonwithheld asset assignment exists. Output conjunction only.
security_model: MPyC 0.11 Shamir protocols, passive adversaries controlling at most one of three parties. Local processes are research roles, not independent organizations. No malicious-security, truthful-input, remote-deployment or physical-dispatch claim.
leakage: One authorized aggregate bit per independent world, plus fixed public dimensions, scenario family, role/source identities and timing/communication metadata. A bit can reveal private information with side information. Fixed scope/epoch and one-use authorization limit adaptive queries.

algorithms.instrument: Secret-shared Hall conditions over every nonempty demand subset of each scenario.
algorithms.independent_oracle: Cleartext backtracking enumeration of injective allocations; does not call the Hall implementation.
algorithms.weak_diagnostic: Each individual request has an eligible usable asset, ignoring contention. This is a diagnostic, not ordinary frontier-model U.
algorithms.competent_same_information: Identical standard MPC artifact invoked from an ordinary library, with the same information; exact parity is the null.
algorithms.human: Estimated development pathway, not an observed human trial.

data: Entirely synthetic declared inventories. No fixture establishes hardware compatibility. Seeds define test cases, not calibrated failure probabilities.
measurement_policy: Preserve all worlds and refusals. Measure exact oracle agreement, diagnostic false positives, elapsed time and bytes. Confidence intervals describe draws from the synthetic generator. Runtime comparisons are descriptive local measurements.
freeze_rule: Resolve construction failures using development/probe cases. Then commit worker, driver, protocol and dependencies before generating fresh confirmation inputs. Preserve and re-freeze any correction with new seeds.
actual_expenditure: Complete real research/API expenditure is unknown; hosted model billing is not exposed. Actual customer collections are zero.
research_batch_authority: A research manifest authorizes the complete fixed batch: one bit for each independent synthetic input world, hence 120 bits for a 120-world batch. The local authority binds the entire batch and prohibits replay. The prospective customer offering authorizes exactly one world per query epoch.
retention_semantics: Asset-specific withholding, not an arbitrary minimum-reserve quota. Each input row is one distinct unit-capacity asset and each demand needs one asset.
